title: The Name of the Rose
author: Umberto Eco
summary: In 1327, a Franciscan friar and his young assistant visit a wealthy Italian abbey to prepare for a theological meeting, and find themselves investigating a series of deaths tied to a forbidden library.
readIf: you want a dense, bookish medieval mystery that is as much about ideas as about the murders.
skipIf: you want a quick read, since it contains long stretches of theology and untranslated Latin.

pairings.reason: Another mystery woven around books and hidden libraries, but warmer and easier going.
A learned, atmospheric literary mystery about brilliant people and a death among them.
Dense, intelligent historical fiction about power and belief, told with a distinctive voice.
